target.title: fix(cron): enforce max concurrent runs across triggers
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where cron's `maxConcurrentRuns` limit was applied separately to scheduled work and manual/on-exit work. Under load, a manual or on-exit run could overlap a full scheduled batch even when the configured limit was `1`.

## Why This Change Was Made

The cron service now owns one FIFO admission boundary for every execution source. Jobs keep a durable per-job reservation while waiting, then revalidate that the reservation is still current and runnable immediately before execution. This prevents duplicate work while also ensuring a disabled, removed, stopped, or rescheduled job cannot run from a stale queued reservation.

## User Impact

Operators can rely on `cron.maxConcurrentRuns` as a real service-wide ceiling across scheduled ticks, `cron.run`, queued manual requests, and on-exit jobs. Forced runs of jobs that were already disabled remain supported.

## Evidence

- `node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config test/vitest/vitest.cron.config.ts src/cron/service.jobs.test.ts src/cron/service.issue-17852-daily-skip.test.ts src/cron/service.list-page-sort-guards.test.ts src/cron/service.issue-13992-regression.test.ts src/cron/service/ops.regression.test.ts src/cron/service/timer.regression.test.ts src/cron/active-jobs-manual-run.test.ts src/cron/service/ops.test.ts src/cron/service/timer.backoff-config-readback.test.ts` — 213 tests passed.
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check` and `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs` passed for the changed files; `git diff --check` passed.
- Final `autoreview --mode local --engine codex --thinking high` reported no actionable findings.
- Remote Testbox proof could not run because this environment is not authenticated to the `openclaw` organization; GitHub CI remains the remote validation path.

AI-assisted implementation and review.
